verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Missive rules that run in timed steps after a trigger (wait, check conditions, act), such as escalating an email at 24, 48 and 72 hours, plus one-off snoozing. These are delayed, event-triggered sequences on a single conversation, not a recurring job schedule. Nothing in the pack documents recurring or cron-style scheduling of jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
